authority: Explicit owner instruction in PR 13 closure task
strategyDenominator: Observed seconds only; UNKNOWN is never zero-candidate evidence.
operationalDenominator: All predetermined scheduled seconds, including invalid and missing slots.
pairScope: Each direction has its own exposure and timestamp-matched candidate frequency. A window needs trusted positive exposure in at least one direction.
jointScope: Window/role top-level exposure is the intersection of both directions; its strategy numerator includes only candidates triggered in that same intersection. Pair evidence remains separately available.
pairedRoleScope: Maker and taker calendar exposure is intersected, not added. Their different strategy frequencies stay in separate role reports.
lateIdentityPolicy: Continue a bounded public scan after T0; measure only current observations after loop entry. Never backfill unknown time.
executionInvalidPolicy: No loop entry, crash, invalid coverage accounting, no trusted positive pair exposure or unavailable frozen authority excludes the row from strategy exposure. Candidate evidence remains unchanged.
phaseABatchEligibility: All six predetermined paired slots must be execution-valid; partial exposure is allowed. Diagnostic requests always count zero. Authority import is separate.
coverageFailureHandling: Sampler/finish exceptions make accounting untrustworthy and execution-invalid; no silent task failure.
nonBlockingRuntimeLimitations: Public pre-T0 identity availability is not established; startup unknown seconds are reported.
Bounded public RPC failures may still produce execution-invalid slots; such slots stay in operational time only.
